content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to set up email notifications with Gmail, Hotmail, and similar services but keep encountering DNS errors. I've checked previous forum posts and followed all recommended solutions, but the issue continues. It seems many other users are having the same trouble, while only a few have managed to get it working. Is there a reliable solution to this problem?
Please try the following settings: Server name: smtp.gmail.com Connection security: STARTTLS Port: 587 Login name: your Gmail address Login password: your Gmail-specific password

Keep in mind that the required password isn't your personal password but the app-specific password generated in your email account profile. This password is 16 characters long. Instructions for creating an app-specific password are available online.

Hello, I've tested all possible ports for Gmail and created a 16-character app password. The test was successful, but when applying these settings on the controller, I keep getting errors. I've also tried using a Hotmail account with the same result. It’s becoming quite frustrating, and I'm wondering if there’s an issue on my internet side.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report persistent DNS failures when attempting to configure email notifications with Gmail and Hotmail on their [product_name] devices. Despite following recommended steps such as setting up correct server details and app-specific passwords, the problem remains widespread, suggesting ongoing connectivity challenges that interfere with reliable email functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect dependable email notifications using mainstream providers on [product_name] hardware and clear guidance for resolving DNS-related configuration issues.
